decision.observation: Level-select screen for section 1-1: black-framed green '1-1' tile plus a green panel showing a circle→square icon (the level preview). Top-right has a play triangle, a square, and an X. Three '0.0%' boxes top-left. No element has changed state after many clicks.
decision.hypothesis: The play triangle at top-right starts the currently selected level/preview (circle-square), so clicking it should launch a level rather than the '1-1' tile which may only select it.
decision.memory: On this screen, clicks on the 1-1 tile and the preview panel produced no visible change. Top-right icons: play triangle (x≈0.836), square (x≈0.896), X (x≈0.955), all y≈0.076. Alternate approaches: play triangle to start the selected level, X to go up a menu level.
